scenario.name: Mandiant UNC1945, CrowdStrike LightBasin & GSMA — Telecom GPRS Tunneling Protocol (GTP) & Roaming Interconnect Forensics
scenario.overview: Imagine a sunlit city park with green lawns, shade trees, winding stone footpaths, wooden benches, and a tiered stone water fountain at the center. Strolling along the city park footpath like an ordinary afternoon walker, a covert courier sits on a wooden bench near the stone fountain and tapes a coded note underneath the armrest. In this real-world scenario, the intruder approaches the park gate footpath disguised as a regular visitor, then smuggles copied records out past the park gate footpath in tiny disguised batches. A watchful park ranger at the corner kiosk notices the exact same bench receiving repeated timed drop-offs and logs the suspicious pattern on the patrol board. In this scenario (T1133, Mandiant UNC1945, CrowdStrike LightBasin & GSMA, Telecom GPRS Tunneling Protocol , GTP & Roaming Interconnect Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: rogue PDP Context Creation Request, then encapsulated GTP-U Inner Packet Routing, then custom PAM Module. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering Rogue PDP Context Creation Request, then Encapsulated GTP-U Inner Packet Routing, then Custom PAM Module, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection pivots on auditd Event 2123 correlated across the documented kill chain.

stages.description: Hidden in plain sight among joggers and park visitors, the pair moves confidential slips across the open park lawn without ever stepping near the guarded city hall across the street. In this final step inside the city park, the intruder smuggles copied records out past the park gate footpath in tiny disguised batches until the park kiosk patrol log catches the mismatch. Next, the follow-up artifact iptables -t nat -L PREROUTING -n -v --line-numbers runs (which executes the technical command / telemetry directive , iptables -t nat -L PREROUTING -n -v --line-numbers via System / Runtime Execution Interface so that advances the scenario kill-chain under MITRE T1556.003 during "Custom PAM Module , /lib64/security/pam_unix_auth.so & iptables Covert Port Rule Audit" , On the Linux/Solaris mobile core server, forensic inspection of /etc/pam while generating verifiable host or network telemetry for DFIR attribution).
